newsitem.title: CHINA: Southwestern China landslide kills 31, injures 5.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern China landslide kills 31, injures 5.

text.p: A landslide in China's southwestern province of Guizhou has killed 31 people and injured five, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Heavy rainstorms that had pounded the province for three days caused the landslide, which destroyed a dozen homes in the early hours of Tuesday in Guizhou's Panxian County, the news agency said.
The local government had sent work teams to the area and begun a round-the-clock effort to look for survivors and aid the victims, it said.
Officials and state media said earlier this week that devastating floods caused by torrential rain had killed at least 110 people in eastern and southern China so far in July.
The floods had forced the closure of 10,000 mines and factories in two of the provinces alone, they said.
